name: Katsuyama Keizou
source:
Yukari's husband, a very quiet man.

He seems to work in a very respectable profession and always comes home at the same time.

Why did he marry Yukari?

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/tmhv.html]official site[/url]]
